closed_world.value: Office building ledge at sixth floor; contained scene with crowd, uniformed officers, and building interior where negotiations occur
closed_world.quote: It was an office building, eight stories high...the ledge that girdled the building at the sixth floor level.

culprit_and_motive.value: Jason Cartwright, suicide threat motivated by marital crisis—wife refuses divorce so he can marry Janice Shapleigh; identity conflict between planned life and authentic self
culprit_and_motive.quote: he found Janice Shapleigh...he'd let him be the strong one...your mother planned for him.

resolution.value: Detective Levine psychologically manipulates Cartwright by urging him to jump, shocking him into emotional breakdown and surrender; Crawley physically retrieves him from ledge
resolution.quote: Jump!...roared Levine...And all at once he began to cry...Crawley came swarming out the other window...And the man came stumbling in from the ledge.

investigator.value: Detective Abraham Levine of Brooklyn's Forty-Third Precinct; sensitive, introspective officer with health anxieties who uses psychological insight rather than force
investigator.quote: Detective Abraham Levine of Brooklyn's Forty-Third Precinct was a worried and a frightened man...Levine stood to one side, watching.
